paite: Huaiziak in ka unau it leh ngaih, ka kipahna leh ka lallukhute aw, Toupa ah kiptak in dingh un, ka itte aw.
heading: Thuhilhna
english: Therefore, my brothers, beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, stand firm in the Lord in this way, my beloved.

paite: Toupa a lungsim kibang pu ding in Euodia ka thuhilh a, Sintikhe ka thuhilh hi.
english: I exhort Euodia, and I exhort Syntyche, to think the same way in the Lord.

paite: Ahi, nou leng ka hon ngen ahi, hakkol puakpih muanhuaite, tanchinhoih a ka na seppih hiai numeite, Klemen leh ka naseppih dangte hinna bu a min tuangte leng na panpih un.
english: Yes, I beg you also, true partner, help these women, for they labored with me in the Good News with Clement also, and the rest of my fellow workers, whose names are in the book of life.

paite: Toupa ah kipak gige un; ka chi nawn ding hi kipak un.
english: Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!”

paite: Na migitna uh mi tengteng kiang ah kithei hen, Toupa anai hi.
english: Let your gentleness be known to all men. The Lord is at hand.

paite: Bangmah lou ah mangbang kei un; himahleh thil bangkim ah, thumna leh ngetna, kipahthu genna toh na ngetnate uh Pathian kiang ah theihsak in om hen.
english: In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.

paite: Huchi in Pathian muanna, lungsim himhim a theih zoh vual louh in Khrist Jesu ah na lungtang leh na ngaihtuahnate uh ahon kepsak ngeingei ding hi.
english: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.

paite: Atawp pen in unaute aw, thil dik peuhmah, thil phathuai peuhmah, thil kilawm peuhmah, thil siangthou peuhmah, thil hoih peuhmah, thil minhoih peuhmah, hoihna himhim a-om a, phatna ding a-omleh huai thilte ngaihtuah un.
english: Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honorable, whatever things are just, whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely, whatever things are of good report: if there is any virtue and if there is anything worthy of praise, think about these things.

paite: Kei a pan na zilkhiakte, tante, zakte leh na muhte uh, huai thilte hih un. Huchi in muanna Pathian na kiang uah a-om ding hi.
english: Do the things which you learned, received, heard, and saw in me, and the God of peace will be with you.

paite: Himahleh nakpitak in Toupa ah ka kipak hi, huchi a tua kei na hon awlmohna uh athak nawn ziak in; na hon limsak mahmah ua, himahleh hun kizen na nei kei ua ahi.
heading: Philippite Tung A Paul Kipahna
english: But I rejoice in the Lord greatly that now at length you have revived your thought for me; in which you did indeed take thought, but you lacked opportunity.

paite: Taksap ziak a hiai thu gen ka hi kei; bangchibang in om mah leng huai a lungkim a omdan ka theikheta hi.
english: Not that I speak because of lack, for I have learned in whatever state I am, to be content in it.

paite: Zawndan ka siam a, hauhdan leng ka siam, mun chih leh thil tengteng a gilvah leh gilkial a omtheihna leh niang leh tasam a omtheihna thuguk ka theikheta hi.
english: I know how to be humbled, and I also know how to abound. In any and all circumstances I have learned the secret both to be filled and to be hungry, both to abound and to be in need.

paite: Ahon hihhatpa Khrist ah thil tengteng ka hihthei hi.
english: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.

paite: Huchi a ka mangbatna a na hon panpih ziak un na hihhoih mahmah uhi.
english: However you did well that you shared in my affliction.

paite: Nou mahmah, nou Philippite ngei in leng tanchinhoih om tung a kipat, Masidonia gam a kipan a ka pai nung, nou chih louh saptuam dang kuamah in piak leh muh lam ah ahon pe kei uh chih na thei uhi.
english: You yourselves also know, you Philippians, that in the beginning of the Good News, when I departed from Macedonia, no assembly shared with me in the matter of giving and receiving but you only.

paite: Thessalonika ah ka taksap awng na hon huksakta uhi.
english: For even in Thessalonica you sent once and again to my need.

paite: Thilpiak ka zon ziak ahi kei a, nou a ding a gahpung zong ka hi zaw hi.
english: Not that I seek for the gift, but I seek for the fruit that increases to your account.

paite: Ahimhim in thil bangkim ka nei a, ka hau a; hihdim in ka om a, noumau a pan bangbang hiam, gimnamtui, kithoihna hoih, Pathian kipaksak, Epaphroditas a kipan in ka na mu hi.
english: But I have all things and abound. I am filled, having received from Epaphroditus the things that came from you, a sweet-smelling fragrance, an acceptable and well-pleasing sacrifice to God.

paite: Huai chiang in ka Pathian in Khrist Jesu thupina ahauhna bang in na taksap tengteng uh ahon pe ngeingei ding hi. hi.
english: My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.

paite: Tu in Pathian leh i Pa uh kiang ah tangtawn, tangtawn in thupina om hen, Amen.
english: Now to our God and Father be the glory forever and ever! Amen.

paite: Khrist Jesu a misiangthou tengteng chibai hon buksak un. Ka kiang a unau omte'n leng chibai ahon buk uhi.
heading: Chibai Bukna Nanung
english: Greet every saint in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me greet you.

paite: Misiangthou tengteng in chibai ahon buk uhi, Kaisar inkuanpihte ahi deuh tuam uhi.
english: All the saints greet you, especially those who are of Caesar’s household.

paite: Toupa Jesu Khrist hehpihna in hon ompih hen, Amen.
english: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
